text_en: The vision of Obadiah. Thus says the Lord God concerning Edom: We have heard a report from the Lord , and a messenger has been sent among the nations: “Rise up! Let us rise against it for battle! ”
text_cn: 亚北底亚的神视。吾主上主关于厄东这样说：我从上主听到了一个消息，有一位传令员已被派往万民那里说：“起来！我们起来向她进攻！”

text_en: I will surely make you least among the nations; you shall be utterly despised.
text_cn: 看，我必使你在万民中成为弱小的，极受人轻视。

text_en: Your proud heart has deceived you, you that live in the clefts of the rock, whose dwelling is in the heights. You say in your heart, “Who will bring me down to the ground? ”
text_cn: 你心中的骄傲欺骗了你：你住在磐石裂缝中，安居高处，心中说：“谁能使我跌在地上？”

text_en: Though you soar aloft like the eagle, though your nest is set among the stars, from there I will bring you down, says the Lord .
text_cn: 即便你高栖如鹰，即便你将巢穴安置在星辰上，我也要从那里把你推下──上主的断语──

text_en: If thieves came to you, if plunderers by night —how you have been destroyed! — would they not steal only what they wanted? If grape-gatherers came to you, would they not leave gleanings?
text_cn: 如果盗贼，或夜间的强盗来到你那里，他们岂不要偷个够吗？如果收葡萄的来到那里，岂不只给你留下些残粒吗？你将来也是如此荒凉！

text_en: How Esau has been pillaged, his treasures searched out!
text_cn: 厄撒乌怎样被人搜过了，她的宝藏怎样被人探索了！

text_en: All your allies have deceived you, they have driven you to the border; your confederates have prevailed against you; those who ate your bread have set a trap for you— there is no understanding of it.
text_cn: 与你联盟的人，愚弄了你，将你驱至边境；与你友好的人，克服了你；与你共食的人，给你暗设了陷阱，而你竟一点也没有理会。

text_en: On that day, says the Lord , I will destroy the wise out of Edom, and understanding out of Mount Esau.
text_cn: 在那一天──上主的断语──我岂能不扑灭厄东的智者，扫除厄撒乌山上的明哲？

text_en: Your warriors shall be shattered, O Teman, so that everyone from Mount Esau will be cut off.
text_cn: 特曼！你的勇士必惊惶失措，致使厄撒乌山上的人尽遭灭亡。你既然好杀，

text_en: For the slaughter and violence done to your brother Jacob, shame shall cover you, and you shall be cut off forever.
text_cn: 残害了你的兄弟雅各伯，你必蒙受羞辱，永遭灭亡：

text_en: On the day that you stood aside, on the day that strangers carried off his wealth, and foreigners entered his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, you too were like one of them.
text_cn: 因为当外邦人掳掠他财物的那一天，蛮族来到了他的城门下，对耶路撒冷拈（niān）阄（jiū）时，你也置身其间，好像他们中的一个。

text_en: But you should not have gloated over your brother on the day of his misfortune; you should not have rejoiced over the people of Judah on the day of their ruin; you should not have boasted on the day of distress.
text_cn: 你兄弟遭难的日子，你不应旁观；犹大子民灭亡的那天，你也不应引以为乐；在患难的日子上，你也不应大言不惭。

text_en: You should not have entered the gate of my people on the day of their calamity; you should not have joined in the gloating over Judah’s disaster on the day of his calamity; you should not have looted his goods on the day of his calamity.
text_cn: 在我的百姓遭难的时日，你不应闯进他们的门；在他遭难的时日，你也不应对他幸灾乐祸；在他遭难的时日，你更不应伸手劫掠他的财物。

text_en: You should not have stood at the crossings to cut off his fugitives; you should not have handed over his survivors on the day of distress.
text_cn: 你不应站在交叉路口，截杀他的难民；在患难之日，你不应交出他的劫后余生。

text_en: For the day of the Lord is near against all the nations. As you have done, it shall be done to you; your deeds shall return on your own head.
text_cn: 因为上主的日子已临近万民，人必按你所作的，照样对待你；你的行为必归于你的头上。

text_en: For as you have drunk on my holy mountain, all the nations around you shall drink; they shall drink and gulp down, and shall be as though they had never been.
text_cn: 正如你们曾在我的圣山上痛饮过，万民也要不断痛饮：他们要痛饮，要饮醉，而终归消灭。

text_en: But on Mount Zion there shall be those that escape, and it shall be holy; and the house of Jacob shall take possession of those who dispossessed them.
text_cn: 但在熙雍山上必有救援，熙雍将是神圣的；并且雅各伯家要侵占那侵占过他们的人。

text_en: The house of Jacob shall be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau stubble; they shall burn them and consume them, and there shall be no survivor of the house of Esau; for the Lord has spoken.
text_cn: 雅各伯家将成为火，若瑟家将成为火焰，厄撒乌家却要成为草秸；雅各伯家和若瑟家要焚烧吞灭他们；厄撒乌家必没有一个余生，因为上主说了。

text_en: Those of the Negeb shall possess Mount Esau, and those of the Shephelah the land of the Philistines; they shall possess the land of Ephraim and the land of Samaria, and Benjamin shall possess Gilead.
text_cn: 他们要占领南方，厄撒乌的山地与培肋舍特的平原，要占领厄弗辣因地和撒玛黎雅地以及阿孟子民的基肋阿得。

text_en: The exiles of the Israelites who are in Halah shall possess Phoenicia as far as Zarephath; and the exiles of Jerusalem who are in Sepharad shall possess the towns of the Negeb.
text_cn: 这支充军在外的以色列子民的军旅，要占领客纳罕人的土地，直到匝尔法特；流亡在色法辣得 的耶路撒冷人，必要占领南方的城邑。

text_en: Those who have been saved shall go up to Mount Zion to rule Mount Esau; and the kingdom shall be the Lord ’s.
text_cn: 那时，获救者必上熙雍山，统治厄撒乌山；王权必归于上主。
